messages:
nina: FYI during the node SDK migration I started seeing a burst of WARNs about missing request_id in logs on cold starts. Not sure if this is an SDK init ordering thing or our sampleapp. Anyone seen this?

alex: Hmm can you paste the exact WARN and which branch/sampleapp?

nina: sampleapp v2 (local), branch `sdk-migrate`. WARN looks like: `WARN logger - request_id missing for trace 0xabc123` repeated a bunch on startup. Happens only for the first ~10s after process start.

jamie: We hit something similar a while back when logger was initialized before the OTEL hooks set up context. Cold start race: HTTP middleware adds req_id but our global logger stamps logs earlier.

samir: Repro steps I used: `git checkout sdk-migrate && npm ci && NODE_ENV=production node ./sampleapp/server.js` then curl a few times. First request logs no req_id, subsequent ones have it.

nina: here's the minimal boot order from sampleapp (this is the patched code):
```js
// server.js
initLogger() // creates bunyan logger global
initOpenTelemetry() // registers OTEL SDK, context propagation hooks
attachHttpMiddleware() // attaches reqid middleware that reads header X-Req-Id
startServer()
```
When I flip initLogger below initOpenTelemetry it fixes it locally. But that feels like a fragile ordering requirement.

alex: Can you try setting the reqid middleware to emit the request id into the logger on first access instead of relying on global logger pre-bound fields? That would be safer across languages.

jamie: Agree. Also we should consider making SDK init idempotent: if OTEL hook registers after logger, it should patch the logger or rebind a context-aware writer. But that's more invasive.

sre-bot: [alert] error-rate spike detected for sampleapp on host devbox-3 at 2065432145 (automated) :rotating_light:

samir: For quick mitigation we added a tiny middleware shim early that sets a default `request_id: unknown` on logger until real id arrives. Ugly but reduces WARN spam.

nina: Can we add a note to the devex sampleapp README about recommended init order and a short snippet for a resilient shim? I can PR one.

alex: Yes please. Suggested content: 1) prefer OTEL/initContext before global logger binds request-scoped fields, 2) show shim code (set placeholder id + swap when real id available), 3) include repro commands and how to run under --trace.

jamie: Also file an SDK issue to add a small helper like `sdk.ensureContextualLogger()` that returns a logger wrapper safe across ordering. We need parity across node/python/go.

nina: I'll open PR for the README and create an SDK GH issue. Assigning to @alex for Node helper prototype.

alex: Ok i'll carve out 1-2 hrs tomorrow. For tracking: logging + reqid + otel-init race.

samir: One more note — redaction tests were failing in CI when we used placeholder `request_id=unknown` because scrubber thought it was a PII pattern. I recommend using `request_id=__missing__` (double underscores) so redact rules can special-case it.

nina: good call. I'll put that in the README PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
